subject: Sync lane: technical deep dive and rotating time-slot proposal

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sync lane: technical deep dive and rotating time-slot proposal

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Medialogic is evaluating a production inference architecture for patient-facing summarization and internal search; latency targets are 150–250ms p50, and you have a mix of EU-hosted data with an APAC operations team that needs regular syncs. You mentioned wanting a focused technical deep dive that includes: (1) network/security architecture, (2) model selection & quantization tradeoffs, and (3) ops/rollout plan.

To make that deep dive actionable, we commonly use a rotating time-slot cadence so regional stakeholders can join at reasonable hours. Attached is an availability grid (availability_grid_v2.xlsx) and an initial mutual action plan (MAP). Below are two rotation patterns — can you indicate which feels closest to your team (or suggest an alternative)? Also confirm the list of attendees so we can invite the right engineers.

Rotation A (simple weekly rotation) — one recurring slot each week that rotates between regions:
- Week 1: Wed 09:00–10:00 PT (US morning)
- Week 2: Thu 17:00–18:00 CET (EU late afternoon)
- Week 3: Fri 10:00–11:00 JST (APAC morning)

Rotation B (paired slots, two-week cadence) — same participants get one US/EU-friendly slot and one APAC-friendly slot every two weeks:
- US/EU slot: Tue 10:00–11:00 PT / Tue 19:00–20:00 CET
- APAC slot: Thu 08:00–09:00 JST

Ask: please reply with (a) preferred rotation (A or B / suggest another), (b) the primary technical contacts for each region (names + emails), and (c) 2–3 candidate dates in the next two weeks. If useful, we can block a one-off single deep dive first and then stand up the rotation.

Thanks — Alex

Alex Martinez
Senior Solution Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192
